name: Samart Aviation Solutions Public Company Limited
summary: Samart Aviation Solutions Public Company Limited (SAV.BK) functions as an investment holding company, primarily providing air traffic control and associated services within Cambodia. Its comprehensive air navigation solutions encompass air traffic management, aeronautical communication systems, vital aeronautical information services, and precise flight procedure design. Established in 2017, the enterprise was formerly named SamartTransolutions Co., Ltd. and is headquartered in Pak Kret, Thailand. The company operates as a subsidiary of Samart U-Trans Co., Ltd.
